checks.backrest: Vertical backrest remains at constant orientation and fixed height behind moving upper back in all nine poses.
checks.seat: Pelvis remains seated; seat/chassis/feet stay fixed.
checks.resistance: Opaque tower hides internal resistance; no stretching/multiplication of exposed plates.
checks.motion: Chest pad and handles move forward/down while upper trunk curls toward pelvis. No chair movement.
checks.geometry: Exactly two human arms/hands and legs/feet, no obvious length distortions.

limitations: Visual source review only; final interpolated motion still requires review.
